text: dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard 是 DSH 主机插件，包装 fetch 检查 Anthropic Messages 请求。请求体超出默认 30000000 字节时，它会重编码大图、替换较早图片，并在必要时截短旧文本，减少长会话请求大小。图像处理需能解析 sharp 模块；配置可调整预算和目标主机。

dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard wraps fetch for Anthropic Messages requests in DSH. Above a 30,000,000-byte budget, it re-encodes large images, replaces older images, and may truncate older text. Image processing requires sharp; the budget and target hosts are configurable.
DSH 调用 Claude 时请求体太大，总是遇到 413 怎么办？
想让长会话里的旧截图变小，避免 Anthropic 消息请求超限。
How can I keep long Claude sessions with screenshots from hitting request_too_large?
dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard 的功能「超限请求缩减」：匹配 Anthropic Messages 请求超预算时，依次重编码大图、替换较早图片，必要时截短较旧文本。
dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard 的功能「图片重编码与缓存」：超限时将可处理的 base64 图片尝试重编码为逐渐缩小尺寸和质量的 JPEG；按内容摘要缓存结果，避免重复计算。

dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard README · dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard：Stops this Claude error in DeepSeek Harness:

```
claude API error (HTTP 413): { "error": { "type": "request_too_large",
  "message": "Request exceeds the maximum size" } }
```

dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard README · dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard：**Cause.** The Anthropic Messages API rejects any request body over 32 MB.
DSH re-sends the whole conversation every turn, including every image in
history as base64. Long agent sessions that take screenshots (Android/iOS
emulators, browsers) add about 1 MB per phone-sized PNG (about 1.33 MB once
encoded), so after a few dozen screenshots every request fails and the session
is stuck. A real stuck session had 34 screenshots at 1280×2856, for a 38 MB request.

dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard README · dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard：**Fix.** This host plugin wraps `fetch` for `api.anthropic.com/v1/messages`
requests. A request under the budget (default 30 MB) passes through
byte-identical. A request over the budget is shrunk, cheapest step first:

dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard README · dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard：1. Re-encode large images as JPEG, starting at a 1568px long edge. Anthropic
   downsamples to about that size anyway, so the model sees practically the
   same image. It steps down (1280, 1024, 768, 512) only if needed.
   That real 38 MB request became 6.1 MB at the first step.
2. If that is still not enough, replace the oldest images with a short text
   placeholder, five at a time, until the request fits.
3. As a last resort, truncate the largest old text blocks (never the latest
   message).

dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard README · dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard：Every step is deterministic and cached by content hash, so the history re-sent
each turn stays byte-identical and the prompt cache keeps hitting.

dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:noahchalifour/dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard
```

Then restart DSH. Image re-encoding uses `sharp`, which DSH already ships.

dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard README · Config：Override in the profile `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: anthropic-request-size-guard
  config:
    maxBytes: 30000000        # body budget in bytes (API limit is 32 MB)
    hosts: [api.anthropic.com]

dsh-anthropic-request-size-guard README · Limitation：Requests routed through a subscriptions-plugin HTTP proxy use undici's own
fetch and bypass the wrapper.
